_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: Statistically honest coil default: score pinned at Complacency ceiling with dead ETF flows, F&G 54, and near-zero funding; no breaker visible so directional call would be unskilled.
next_move.brains_agree: Yes on no aggressive directional move—analyst explicit HOLD/Complacency; narrative describes balanced/fading spot demand without a bullish or bearish impulse
next_move.confirmed_if: F&G holds 47-54, 12h score changes stay inside ±2, funding pinned near zero, ETF flows remain dead
next_move.invalidated_if: Score breaks ±2 out of 47-54—F&G >55 with ETF flows turning up, or F&G <46 as crowded long/skew complex unwinds
